name: hireorbitai
description: HireOrbit AI monorepo — npm workspaces over backend/, frontend/, shared/.

scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared:build && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run shared:build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run build && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
scripts.mobile:typecheck: npm run shared:build && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
